_comment: Canonical list of top-level FFT game states (the 'spine' the state navigator drives). Hand-authored from research/working_documents/GAME_STATE_TRANSITIONS.md §1 — NOT ROM-derived. `order` fixes the GameState.gd enum value; `slug` is the enum member name lower-cased. `category`: scenario_graph = a node in transition_graph.json; front_end = a menu state off the graph. `graph_kinds`/`graph_successor` map transition_graph.json node kinds & successors onto the owning state (used by GameState.for_node_kind / for_successor). `re_status`: dyn (live-confirmed) / partial / open. Keep GameState.gd + GameStateTest in sync — the test asserts parity.

states.description: OPNBK1 background + main menu (NEW GAME / CONTINUE / ...). Boot entry.
states.re_note: Assets only; menu wiring not RE'd.

states.description: Event-script VM playing a cinematic node; world built from an ATTACK.OUT record (map + ENTD + music). Every non-battle graph node.
states.re_note: VM, loading, chaining all live-confirmed. See INTER_SCENE_ORCHESTRATION.md.

states.description: Tactical combat. A battle IS a group: the setup node owns a BattleConditionals set that weaves cinematic members in by predicate (opener / mid-combat / victory).
states.re_note: Load/roster live-confirmed; battle-END routing (BC evaluator fn) still OPEN. See WITHIN_GROUP_MEMBER_TRANSITION.md.

states.description: Pre-battle squad-placement menu (choose & position units before combat).
states.re_note: Entry 0x80079320 -> struct 0x80098D88 identified; state machine not RE'd. In Godot it is folded into the GPUArena Strategy phase.

states.description: Overworld travel hub. Target of every post_scenario_step=0x80 edge; WLDCORE.BIN holds random encounters. Gateway to the front-end menus.
states.re_note: RE'd across 14 rounds off three world-map savestates — WORLD_MAP_SCREEN.md. wldgen.py emits the settled frame's primitives packet-for-packet (60/60 main list, 12/12 ribbon) on two captures, and the Godot port renders 99.59% pixel-exact against the console framebuffer. The 0x80 fork is the 0x80 `world-map` successor and is now a live transition (godot-learning/docs/WORLD_MAP_PORT_LIST.md crossing C2). Node-event dispatch — the 182 per-node scripts — is decoded but not wired (crossing X1).

states.description: Front-end party 'sort list' roster screen, reached World Map -> Menu.
states.re_note: Assets parsed (UNIT.BIN atlas, background, orb); upload path + roster data struct OPEN. See FORMATION_SCREEN.md.

states.description: Target of post_scenario_step=0x82. Returns to the title/boot.
states.re_note: Edge decoded; the game-over screen itself not RE'd.

states.description: Universal pre-combat setup breakpoint: the battle config (units placed at ENTD spots, teams, roster->slot binding) is built and presented before combat starts. Roster-fed battles host the DEPLOYMENT placement here; predetermined battles (Orbonne, the one control>0 battle) present the fixed config. Gate = ENTD control flag (GAME_STATE_TRANSITIONS.md 2.6).
states.re_note: Navigator-side construct (not a distinct PSX state) — the pause where the config is presentable before combat. Deployment placement folds into src/strategy/ (StrategyPhaseManager PLACEMENT vs CONFIGURATION).
